name: document_ops
description: Document operations for Word (.docx) files: create, read, and edit documents. Uses python-docx. Read-only operations never modify files; write operations require authorized=true plus confirm=true plus a policy allow rule. All file paths are resolved against the workspace root - nothing is written outside it.

operation.description: One of: create | read | edit | sources. Defaults to sources.

content.description: Document content/body text for create or edit.

authorized.description: Must be true for write operations (create, edit).

confirm.description: Must be true to actually write a file.

author: Stella
notes: Uses python-docx. Write operations are destructive and need authorized=true + confirm=true + an allow rule. Paths are confined to the workspace root.
